name: April
title: Where to go on holiday in April
intro: Spring arrives across Europe in April, with cities like Rome, Paris and Lisbon before the summer crowds. It's also a good month for Japan, Jordan and the Caribbean.
seo_title: Where is hot in April? Easter sun and where to go

faqs.question: Where is warm for Easter?
faqs.answer: Malta, Cyprus (Paphos), Madeira, Cape Verde and Marrakech are all warm enough for T-shirts. Further away, Mauritius, Barbados and Mexico are in their dry season.

faqs.question: Is April a good time for a city break?
faqs.answer: It's one of the best. Rome, Paris, Lisbon, Porto, Valencia, Amsterdam and New York are pleasantly warm, the queues are shorter than in summer, and the days are long enough for a lot of walking.

faqs.question: Is April good for Japan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The start of April is often still cherry blossom season in Tokyo, and it's lovely in Kanazawa too. Avoid the last few days of April into early May, which is Golden Week, when Japan itself goes on holiday.
